Mocha Ray Cookie is a dark skinned, half cookie, half stingray humanoid of a bit more than average height. She has orange eyes, small green eyebrows, and orange hair, along with orange side bangs. She has a cute, content resting face and almost always has her eyes closed, making it hard to read her. Mocha Ray Cookie wears a long robe and headwear that resembles that of a brown stingray with a pale yellow underside. Her headwear used to have two green crystals, but they faded away with Sugarteara.

Mocha Ray Cookie used to be the guardian of the Sugarteara Temple, guarding the temple and the pearl housed within it diligently; although after an incident regarding the maker of the pearl, Sea Fairy Cookie, all of Sugarteara was absorbed into the pearl and left without a trace due to the aftermath of the pearl's needed purification. As of right now, she's working with another guardian of Sugarteara, Lobster Cookie, to rebuild Sugarteara to 
bring it back to an even better state.

Mocha Ray Cookie is a kind, polite, but mysterious character, almost always having a content smile on her face; it's hard to know what's going on in her head. She is very patient, often willing the see the reasoning behind something before getting accusatory in a situation. Mocha Ray Cookie is also smart, being able to make good decisions quickly when the time calls for it. Despite her calm demeanor, Mocha Ray Cookie is actually very shy, and can get easily flustered; she's spent a good bit of her life guarding the Sugarteara Temple alone, so she isn't all that used to new faces, especially kind ones.

Mocha Ray Cookie has an enchanting mocha aroma. Mocha Ray Cookie is able to call upon a giant stingray called The Great Stingray; she mostly uses them for transportation. Because she's half stingray, Mocha Ray Cookie has electrical abilities. The long robe she wears makes it seem like Mocha Ray Cookie might be a bit stiff, but she is actually extremely flexible.

Mocha Ray Cookie speaks in a calm, modern, manner (while also being just a little bit sophisticated); although, she will stutter and might lose her calm tone if she gets flustered.
